title: The verifier's delivery check, counted set and tally openings under a rolling definition (definition version 7, electorate_mode 2; ballot version 5, delivery records version 2, tally-opening version 1, without an author panel): definitions, clocks, boards and the pinned panel, with the rows 5.9, 6.3, 7.1 to 7.4 and 8.5, the report's delivery, cells and tallies and the counted ballots' entries, beside verifier-ballots-v5.json's group registry events and registration time
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-counted-v5-rolling-vectors.py, from verifier-ballots-v5-vectors.py, ballot-v5-records-vectors.py, verifier-ceremony-vectors.py, ceremony-vectors.py, delivery-vectors.py, delivery-v2-vectors.py, intake-v4-vectors.py, tally-opening-vectors.py, tally-vectors.py and verifier-openings-vectors.py (independent Python implementations); the ballot records are verifier-ballots-v5.json's

cases.description: A sealed rolling poll without an author panel (pick one of three, pick up to two of four, pick exactly one of two), one cell per rolling tier (tiers 0 and 2); seats 1 to 3 registered. In segment 0 the transcript and three ballots of distinct nullifiers: dan's (cell 0, step N0), tess's (cell 1) and eve's (cell 0, the step whose boundary is closes_at). In segment 3 every registered seat receipts each ballot by its version-5 ballot hash, beside seat 1's receipt for dan's fields relabelled to the next step and seat 2's for tess's fields read as version 4, each naming no selected ballot, so neither is reported. In segment 4 an honest opening of each cell (cell 0 over dan's and eve's ballots by seat 1, cell 1 over tess's by seat 2). Every ballot is delivered and counted, and 7.2 passes; no seat states destruction (8.5).

As delivered, but seat 1's only receipt for dan's ballot names dan's fields at the next step: version 5's ballot hash binds the step, so it names no selected ballot and dan's ballot misses seat 1 and isn't counted (T-38). Cell 0 is opened over eve's ballot alone, and 7.2 passes.

As delivered, but every receipt for tess's ballot names its fields' version-4 ballot hash: none names a selected ballot, so tess's ballot misses seats 1 to 3 and isn't counted. Cell 1 is empty, its honest opening (0, 0) for every option against the identity aggregate, and 7.2 passes with a count of 0.
Every ballot delivered, but cell 0's only opening is over eve's ballot alone, as if dan's weren't counted: its aggregate isn't cell 0's, so 7.2 fails at cell 0 with tally-opening.
Every ballot delivered and cell 0 opened, but no opening of cell 1, tier 2's: 7.2 fails at cell 1 with tally-missing.

Every ballot delivered and each cell opened honestly (cell 0 by seat 1, cell 1 by seat 2), then: seat 3's opening naming cell 2, a stray opening, since the partition is one cell per rolling tier and there are two (tally-stray); seat 1's second opening of cell 0, over eve's ballot alone (tally-aggregate, and tally-second: evidence against the seat); seat 2's opening of cell 1 boarded again byte for byte (tally-repeat, the operator's alone); and seat 3's honest opening of cell 1, which passes beside seat 2's. 7.2 passes; 7.4 fails at the first break, tally-stray.
